A.objective: Using only authoritative data-room sources, determine which represented billed revenue is tied to counterparties whose active contracts contain acquisition-relevant conditions, and report each qualifying invoice with source-native identifiers and invoice attributes.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only; no external knowledge.
entities_in_scope: counterparties named on invoices and contracts
exclusions: expired statements of work are not active contracts
invoices without a qualifying active contract and acquisition-relevant clause are out of scope for inclusion

required_output_shape.identifier_rendering: Report invoice_id and contract_id as they appear in sources (consumer may strip prefixes downstream).

world_eligible: invoice exists with billed_name, amount, currency, period, status as represented in billing sources
contract exists and is identifiable by source-native contract identifier
contract counterparty text as represented in contract sources
contractual clause text or structured extraction of clause kinds present in a contract
contract active vs expired status as a source-grounded temporal/state fact
invoice-to-contract linkage when confidently established from sources or mechanical joins
purpose_analytical: acquisition-relevant condition: clause kind matching change-of-control consent/notice, change-of-control termination right, or assignment consent/notice restriction (including affiliate-only assignment, competitor prohibition)
qualifying invoice: billed revenue row included because it satisfies purpose inclusion policy (active contract + acquisition-relevant clause)
association disposition: asserted vs unresolved for invoice billed_name to contract counterparty

epistemic_requirements: Missing or uncertain identity between a billed name and a contract counterparty must not be treated as a negative contractual finding.
When invoice-to-contract counterparty association cannot be made confidently, emit the invoice with association=unresolved rather than omitting it or asserting a join.
Positive inclusion (association=asserted) requires confident linkage; absence of confidence is not evidence of non-exposure.
Ground persistent world assertions; purpose output reflects analytical disposition under stated policies.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: Invoice is in scope for reporting but billed_name-to-contract counterparty linkage is not confidently established.

completeness_expectations.row_coverage: Every invoice that qualifies under purpose inclusion policy (represented billed revenue on an active contract with an acquisition-relevant condition) must appear in output.
completeness_expectations.field_coverage: For each included invoice, populate amount, currency, period, status, contract_id from sources; association must be asserted or unresolved.
completeness_expectations.sorting: Complete sorted list by invoice_id; no silent drops for unresolved association.
completeness_expectations.receipt_note: Completeness is relative to purpose-defined qualifying set, not closed-world negation over all invoices.

includes: consent or notice required on change of control
termination permitted upon change of control
consent or notice required before assignment, including assignment restricted to affiliates only or prohibited to competitors
acquisition_relevant_conditions.world_distinction: World may record clause text and extracted clause kinds; acquisition-relevance is the analytical filter for purpose A.

active_contract.rule: An expired statement of work is not an active contract for this purpose.
active_contract.world_distinction: World may record contract type, dates, and status facts; active-for-purpose-A is a policy classification.

row_inclusion.rule: Include invoice rows where the governing contract is active under purpose policy and contains at least one acquisition-relevant condition.

association_mapping.asserted: Confident invoice billed_name to contract counterparty association established.
association_mapping.unresolved: Association not confidently established; still report invoice if otherwise qualifying.

output_constraints: Do not omit qualifying invoices solely because association is unresolved.

B.objective: Using only authoritative data-room sources, reconcile represented customer and commercial identities across CRM, billing, company registry, and contracts; report whether records can be confidently treated as the same legal counterparty or remain unresolved.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.
universe_scope.entities_in_scope: Every commercially relevant name or record needed to connect CRM, billing, contract, and registry candidates for a relationship.

required_output_shape.ordering: Sort links by left ascending, then right ascending.

world_eligible: CRM account records with account identifiers and names as represented
invoice billed names as represented in billing
registry rows with company numbers and legal names
contract filenames and counterparty text as represented
identity_judgment between two referents: SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED with bounded evidence
purpose_analytical: required link set: pairs needed to connect a CRM account, its billed name, the governing contract, and candidate registry legal entities for that relationship
orientation policy: class-rank ordering of emitted links
mechanical same-entity allowance for exact legal-form variants of the same registered name

epistemic_requirements: Do not globally merge records merely because two names look similar.
Exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be treated as mechanical same-entity judgments.
Distinct registry entities with similar trade names are not automatically the same party.
Missing a positive same-entity judgment is not a negative (DISTINCT) judgment.
Explicit UNRESOLVED is permitted and preferred over speculative SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT.
SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not mere compatibility or string similarity.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: Insufficient evidence to assert SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT for the left-right pair.

completeness_expectations.link_coverage: Include every link required to connect a CRM account, its billed name, the contract governing that relationship, and any registry row that is a candidate legal entity for that relationship.
completeness_expectations.pair_orientation: Emit directed left/right pairs per schema; cover required connectivity without claiming global entity closure.
completeness_expectations.sorting: Complete sorted list by left then right.
completeness_expectations.receipt_note: Completeness targets required relationship wiring, not an exhaustive all-pairs Cartesian product over the data room.

merge_policy.forbid: Global merge on fuzzy or similar-looking names alone.
merge_policy.permit_mechanical: Exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be collapsed mechanically.

negative_judgment_policy.rule: Absence of SAME_ENTITY is not DISTINCT; DISTINCT requires positive establishing evidence.

required_link_set.rule: Emit links connecting CRM account, billed name, governing contract, and registry candidates for each commercially relevant relationship.

disposition_vocabulary.world_alignment: Maps to identity_judgment dispositions; REJECT (if used in resolution) maps to DISTINCT in output per consumer contract.

output_constraints: Use prescribed identifier prefix forms only.

C.objective: Using only authoritative data-room sources, compute a commercial dependency view: identify counterparties that are commercially dependent under a two-part test involving current commercial relationship and specific obligation kinds in active contracts.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.
exclusions: expired contracts do not create current dependency
one-off paid historical invoice without an active contract does not create current dependency

required_output_shape.identifier_forms: Same as purpose B (crm:, billing:, registry:, contract:).
required_output_shape.ordering: Sort dependencies by contract_id ascending; obligation_kinds sorted within each row.

world_eligible: invoice open vs closed/paid status as represented
contract active vs expired status and term structure as represented
presence of exclusivity, auto-renewal, or rolling-term clauses in contract text or extractions
counterparty referents linkable across billing and contracts when identity is established
purpose_analytical: current commercial relationship: open invoice OR active contract that auto-renews or continues on a rolling term
commercial dependency: both current relationship and at least one obligation kind from {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}
status dependent vs unresolved when identity joins required for the dependency view are not confident

epistemic_requirements: If identity needed to join invoice and contract is unresolved, report dependency status=unresolved rather than status=dependent or silently excluding the row.
Unresolved identity is not evidence of non-dependency.
Dependency is a purpose classification over world facts, not a bare contract-exists fact.
Ground world facts about invoice status, contract terms, and clause kinds separately from the dependent/unresolved disposition.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: Counterparty-contract-invoice dependency cannot be confidently computed because required identity linkage is unresolved or evidence is insufficient under purpose policies.

completeness_expectations.row_coverage: Emit a dependency row for each counterparty-contract candidate that meets or plausibly meets the dependency test; mark unresolved rather than omit when joins fail.
completeness_expectations.field_coverage: Populate open_invoice_ids (possibly empty when relationship is contract-only), obligation_kinds (sorted subset of vocabulary), and counterparty identifier.
completeness_expectations.receipt_note: Completeness does not require asserting non-dependency rows for excluded cases (expired-only, historical one-off); exclusions are purpose policy, not closed-world negation.

requires_both.name: current_commercial_relationship
satisfiers: open invoice exists for the counterparty relationship
active contract that auto-renews or continues on a rolling term

dependency_test.world_distinction: World records invoice status, contract term facts, and clause kinds; dependent is the conjunction under this policy.

rules: Expired contracts do not create current dependency.
A one-off paid historical invoice without an active contract does not create current dependency.

identity_dependency.rule: Reuse purpose B identifier forms and identity judgments; unresolved cross-source identity forces status=unresolved for purpose C.

obligation_kinds.output_rule: Sorted list of kinds present in the active contract for the row.

output_constraints: Do not report false non-dependency when identity is unresolved.
